# AmzLoss

> AmzLoss is the independent check on Amazon Associates payouts. In 2026 Amazon cut affiliate commissions by up to 50% and removed detailed reporting, leaving affiliates unable to verify what they actually earned. AmzLoss lets any Amazon Associate audit their own earnings report — entirely in their browser, with no data uploaded — to find possible underpayments, quantify the impact of rate cuts, and generate claim reports.

## Tools
- [Earnings Audit](https://amzloss.com/audit.html): Upload your Amazon Associates earnings CSV. It is parsed 100% in your browser and compared against the published commission rates. Returns a summary, worst categories, and flagged "possible irregularity" line items (returns and ambiguous rows are excluded). No account or upload required.
- [Commission Calculator](https://amzloss.com/calculator.html): Pick your market and category, enter your price and monthly sales, and see what you earned before the rate cuts vs. now, plus your monthly and annualised loss.
- [Current Rates](https://amzloss.com/rates.html): Amazon Associates commission rates by category for 2026, with the pre-cut rate for comparison.

## Pricing
- Launch offer: until 2026-09-10 the full tool is unlocked for everyone with no ads. Paying is optional support.
- Free: rate table, calculator, audit summary, worst categories, top 3 flagged items, and rate-change alerts. Ad-supported after launch.
- Paid (weekly ₦2,332.20, monthly ₦6,232.20, yearly ₦46,020.00): unlocks the full flagged line-item list, the claim export, and removes all ads.

## FAQ
- [FAQ](https://amzloss.com/faq.html): Answers to the most asked Amazon Associates questions — commission rates, how much affiliates earn, the 24-hour cookie, why earnings drop, returns, bounties, disclosure, and how to audit for underpayments.

## Learn
- [Amazon Halo Commission Gone (April 14)](https://amzloss.com/blogs/amazon-halo-commission-gone.html): Since April 14, 2026 Amazon pays only on the ASIN you linked. What changed, the 180-day deadline, and how to check the impact.
- [Amazon 2026 Commission Cuts](https://amzloss.com/blogs/amazon-2026-commission-cuts.html): What changed, which categories were hit, and how to measure the impact on your account.
- [Why Earnings Dropped But Clicks Didn't](https://amzloss.com/blogs/why-earnings-dropped-but-clicks-didnt.html): Rate cuts vs. category drift vs. tracking — how to tell them apart with EPC.
- [How to Audit Your Amazon Earnings Report](https://amzloss.com/blogs/how-to-audit-amazon-earnings.html): Step-by-step audit walkthrough using your own CSV.
- [How to Check for Amazon Affiliate Underpayment](https://amzloss.com/blogs/how-to-check-amazon-affiliate-underpayment.html): Export your report, compare each line against 2026 rates, and total the shortfall.
- [Amazon Associates Missing Commission](https://amzloss.com/blogs/amazon-associates-missing-commission.html): The eight most common reasons commission goes missing and how to check each.
- [Amazon Product Earnings Report CSV Explained](https://amzloss.com/blogs/amazon-product-earnings-report-csv-explained.html): Column-by-column guide to reading your Product Earnings Report CSV.

## Key facts
- Processing is 100% client-side; AmzLoss never uploads, stores, or sees your earnings data.
- Results are labelled "possible irregularity" — never a guaranteed claim — to avoid false positives from returns, bounties, or delayed shipping.
- Payments are handled by Paystack; AmzLoss never stores card details.
- During launch (until 2026-09-10) the entire tool is free with no ads.
- AmzLoss is independent and not affiliated with Amazon or Amazon Associates.
